scientific_integrity: The characteristic polynomial, exceptional-point classification, exact entropy-production identity and convex optimization proof are analytical. The 2,274 checker assertions are auxiliary and do not establish novelty or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to strictly positive continuous-time three-state ring rates with uniform stationary law, common circulation and fixed total symmetric edge activity. It does not apply to discrete-time quantum channels or larger networks. Earlier specialization in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Disorder barriers and a sharp dissipation–frequency frontier on a three-state Markov cycle
